testCases.name: Find BHS Leadership Page
testCases.goal: 1. Navigate to the About BHS dropdown but do not click it. 2. Navigate within the dropdown and click BHS Leadership. 3. Report success once you click the link, with the reason as the url.

testCases.name: Find Corrections Contact Page
testCases.goal: 1. Navigate to and click the Government dropdown. 2. Within the dropdown, navigate to and click Branches of Government. 3. Navigate to and click Executive Branch. 4. Navigate to and click the MDOC Organization link. Report success after clicking the link, with the reason as the url.

testCases.name: Find Financial Aid Disbursement Page
testCases.goal: 1. Navigate to and click the Admission dropdown. 2. Within the dropdown, navigate to and click Access and Affordability. 3. Navigate to and click Understanding your Offer. 4. Navigate to and click the financial aid disbursement link. Report success after clicking the link, with the reason as the url.
